description: This file defines a WearableListenerService subclass used to handle data change events and notification updates in an Android Wearable application. It manages the creation and dismissal of notifications based on data item events from the Wearable DataApi.

classes.name: NotificationUpdateService
classes.description: A service that listens for data item changes from the Wearable DataApi and updates or dismisses notifications on an Android Wear device accordingly. Handles connection to GoogleApiClient, processes data change events, and manages notification lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient for communication with the Wearable DataApi.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, particularly dismissing notifications if the appropriate action is received.

methods.name: dismissPhoneNotification
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient to initiate dismissal of a notification via data item deletion.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes data change and deletion events to update or dismiss notifications accordingly.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a simple notification on the wearable device, optionally including a dismissal intent.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Performs data item deletion to dismiss notifications when the API client connects.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the data items deletion operation, logging errors if unsuccessful.
